LESSON: WRITING 2.3.1 ESSAY WRITING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we write an essay?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. compose an essay on a specific theme for communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 2.3.1 ESSAY WRITING
This lesson teaches Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing for Grade 7 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. compose an essay on a specific theme for communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing above.
2. Explain Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we write an essay?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. compose an essay on a specific theme for communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
